subject: [RFC PATCH v2 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Suggested removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely to simplify the code and prepare for future changes. Also suggested disallowing converting ordinary pages to folios and vice versa.

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)
reviews.summary: Agreed to post a separate series that removes ->try_steal and its users, with SPLICE_F_MOVE, SPLICE_F_GIFT, and FUSE_SPLICE_MOVE left as no-ops.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: The patch series aims to improve the handling of folios in the FUSE file system, specifically addressing issues related to PG_rcu_free and page cache reads. The main goal is to prevent folios from being moved into a fuse file when they are still being copied by a lockless page cache read. To achieve this, the patch introduces a check for PG_rcu_free in fuse_try_move_folio() and copies such folios instead of moving them.

reviews.author: Linus Torvalds
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion to remove fuse_try_move_folio() and also suggested removing pipe_buf_try_steal() entirely.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 06:46, David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org> wrote:
>
> Could we get rid of fuse_try_move_folio() entirely?

Please. That would be great.

              Linus
